scope.majority_rule: Strictly more than 23 of the other 46 in the same direction, separately for each mode.
scope.population: Previously exposed fixed48 validation engineering records only.

interpretation: Every query timer is centered on its own same-stage/arm/position six-pair median, including itself. Four fixed cases have two arms each; no stage, arm or window is pooled. Other-query summaries always exclude positions32/33, giving exactly46 equally weighted positions. Raw direction and strict plus/minus1ms descriptions are separate, including their target signs and strict-majority directions. One millisecond is a descriptive scale, not significance. Zero or within-threshold target direction leaves same/opposite counts and alignment undefined. Neutral-majority does not imply a directional majority. Differences are relative to historical medians, not paired C-minus-R effects or elapsed-time components. Same run does not mean simultaneous queries; fixed query order and shared baselines do not establish independence, host load, CPU, I/O or decoder causality. Other-five summaries remain overlapping descriptive references. No new experiment, query, decode or fit is run.
